import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    base = []
    while m > 0:
        base.append(m % w)
        m //= w
    
    possible = True
    for i in range(len(base)):
        if base[i] > 1:
            base[i] += 1
            if base[i] == w:
                idx = i
                while idx < len(base) and base[idx] >= w:
                    base[idx] = 0
                    if idx + 1 == len(base):
                        base.append(1)
                    else:
                        base[idx + 1] += 1
                    idx += 1
            if base[i] > 1:
                possible = False
                break
    
    print("YES" if possible else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
